_roadmap: OPS/units/COMP-COCKPIT-RIBBON-CUT-1/cut.md; owner pick Day ribbon, OPS/units/COMP-COCKPIT-UX-ADJ-1/report.md Shape 1
_note: The feed author copies this file to C/docs/features/COMP-COCKPIT-RIBBON-FEED-1/ribbon-contract.json in the landing commit. RIBBON-ROWS-1 builds against fixtures of this shape. Times are ISO-8601 strings with offset; null means not recorded, never zero.

errors.400: {error} when from/to missing, unparseable, from >= to, or to - from > 31 days
errors.absent: route not mounted in remote mode (same guard as /api/process)

lanes.idle: bool: no current unit and no span or mark in the window
lanes.current: {id, title, titleSource, since} | null (null in a past window)

spans.title: string | null
spans.why: plain words for the tooltip, e.g. 'waiting on review 3 h' or 'not recorded: no dispatch stamp (rule U-d)'

marks.title: string | null
marks.reverse: string | null (decide only: how to reverse, from the source row)

lanes.eta: {p50, p80, asOf, raw, prev: {p50, asOf} | null} | {noData: true, raw} | null. p50 and p80 are strings exactly as estimate.py prints them: a duration such as "9h" or "2d" (the live shape), and a time with an offset is also read. asOf is the estimator's own local time WITHOUT a zone ("2026-10-31T20:14"). raw is the estimator's debug line and is never shown.

sourceErrors.<source>: string (plain words; the source still renders as not recorded)
